confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors rest on aggregator and guide sources of mixed age (a Expatistan cappuccino price dated 2023, a Morocco-wide July 2026 bar guide, and Expatistan and GlobalCostData price points from 2026, with GlobalCostData's meal figure being a national proxy). Cocktail and wine anchors are not from direct Tangier price data: cocktail is set at about 2.6x the beer anchor and wine glass at about 1.4x, based on local bar and wine pricing relationships. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no accommodation searches were run and no booking pages or current listings were inspected. The FX observation is taken from an RBA statistics summary dated 2026-10-16. That search summary was internally inconsistent, naming 2026-10-15 as latest in one sentence, and the raw RBA figures were not visible to me, so the value should be verified against the RBA table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct comparable city was used. Food anchors are anchored on Tangier-specific aggregator price points (Expatistan dinner-for-two and lunch-menu figures, a fast-food combo reference) and cross-checked against the GlobalCostData Morocco-level inexpensive-meal proxy. Beer is anchored on a July 2026 Morocco-wide bar guide's 25cl domestic-beer range. Cocktail and wine glass are derived from the beer anchor using local bar and wine pricing (spirits and bottled local wine benchmarks), as no Tangier cocktail or wine prices were found. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for a mid-sized North African Mediterranean port with mixed budget and mid-range hotel stock.
